channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2014-0780 — InduSoft Web Studio
item.description: Threat Signal 79. InduSoft Web Studio NTWebServer contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows remote attackers to read administrative passwords in APP files, allowing for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-40217 — BerriAI LiteLLM
item.description: Threat Signal 79. BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

item.title: CVE-2026-8452 — Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2025-32975 — Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA)
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate users without valid credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-85706 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 83. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

item.title: CVE-2023-27351 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 83. PaperCut NG/MF contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations via the SecurityRequestFilter class.

item.title: CVE-2025-49706 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft SharePoint contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network. Successfully exploitation could allow an attacker to view sensitive information and make some changes to disclosed information. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49704. CVE-2025-53771 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49706, and the updates for CVE-2025-53771 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49706.

item.title: CVE-2024-9474 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation through the web-based management interface for several PAN products, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.

item.title: CVE-2021-27877 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the BE Agent via SHA authentication scheme.

item.title: CVE-2022-41080 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. This vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082, which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-2551 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code via a crafted web site that triggers access to a deleted object.

item.title: CVE-2018-8174 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 83. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the VBScript engine handles objects in memory, aka "Windows VBScript Engine Remote Code Execution"

item.title: CVE-2021-31207 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for security feature bypass.

item.title: CVE-2021-1675 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-3199 — ONLYOFFICE Docs
item.description: Threat Signal 82. ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-93616 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

item.title: CVE-2026-20079 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-72898 — Metabase Metabase
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

item.title: CVE-2026-8037 — Progress LoadMaster
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2026-10520 — Ivanti Sentry
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Sentry (formerly known as MobileIron Sentry) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthenticated user to achieve root-level remote code execution. This vulnerability can be successfully exploited in cases where the Sentry appliance is in an unmanaged state with its endpoints externally reachable. The use of mTLS with EPMM or restricted HTTPS access through Neurons for MDM makes interfaces inaccessible to external actors.

item.title: CVE-2008-4250 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Windows contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Server Service that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted RPC request that triggers an overflow during path canonicalization.

item.title: CVE-2023-21529 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Exchange Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data that allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-21643 — Fortinet FortiClient EMS
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

item.title: CVE-2026-1340 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-32432 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2017-7921 — Hikvision Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Multiple Hikvision products contain an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a malicious user to escalate privileges on the system and gain access to sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2026-1281 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-24061 — GNU InetUtils
item.description: Threat Signal 82. GNU InetUtils contains an argument injection vulnerability in telnetd that could allow for remote authentication bypass via a "-f root" value for the USER environment variable.

item.title: CVE-2022-24990 — TerraMaster TerraMaster OS
item.description: Threat Signal 82. TerraMaster OS contains a remote command execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands on the target endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2022-2294 — WebRTC WebRTC
item.description: Threat Signal 82. WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

item.title: CVE-2016-0034 — Microsoft Silverlight
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Silverlight mishandles negative offsets during decoding, which allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2013-0074 — Microsoft Silverlight
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Silverlight does not properly validate pointers during HTML object rendering, which allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Silverlight application.

item.title: CVE-2017-0213 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Windows COM Aggregate Marshaler allows for privilege escalation when an attacker runs a specially crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2021-40449 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Unspecified vulnerability allows for an authenticated user to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2016-7255 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Win32k kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory which allows for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2021-1732 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-97229 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 81. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli
item.description: Threat Signal 81. Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.
